source: Retina OCT atlas (third-party index of OLIVES)
image_format: WebP derivative (downsampled by the atlas; not the original TIFF/PNG)
dataset: OLIVES (Prabhushankar et al., NeurIPS Datasets and Benchmarks 2022), CC BY 4.0, doi:10.5281/zenodo.7105232
verification: each kept image: atlas path == visit_images.csv file_path of the expected visit; eye_id, patient_id, laterality, visit label, subject, BCVA and CST equal episodes.csv
caveat: Pixel content is as served by the atlas. It has not been compared byte-for-byte with the official Zenodo archive.
